F 1 scores are commonly used for evaluating constituency parsing performance . In our work of unsupervised discontinuous constituency parsing, we report corpuslevel F 1 scores of all constituents, continuous constituents, and discontinuous constituents, denoted by F overall 1 , F cont 1 , and F disco 1 , respectively.
